comments.body: Great Aide for adventurers, with all languages of East Asia and nice skills.

comments.author: Emma
comments.body: Why would you think this is a nice aide, he has double shot defense but then no other battle skill for lieutenant job, for adventure he only has archeology and geography which isn't much, also no production skill or any other highly valued skill, seems pretty average to me (ie, not NC material yet he is NC).

comments.author: Igor
comments.body: All East Asia aides are NC just because NM was thinking that people will buy these... didnt considered that most EA aides are average, or superated by some normal aides... also, almost any player that can access EA have defined his aide group... simply: greed...

comments.author: Wen zhi
comments.body: He good aide since he has all three East Asia languages. You wouldn't need to waste skill slot or swap languages to read achieve. A convenience for adventurers.

comments.author: Sophia
comments.body: Outside his language skills of knowing Chinese, Japanese, and Korean, he's a mediocre aide, especially for an NC aide. They are far better Adventure and NC aides to get. Maybe if this wasn't an AC aide or if in the future we can hire an extra aide id consider it.
